name: bollinger_price_action_5s
author: adapted from aggregated_from_x_indian_traders
thesis: Exploiting price action rejection at Bollinger Band extremes in directional bias. Inefficiency from retail panic at bands without PA confirmation. Persists due to VIX filter requirement and institutional support at bands.
mechanism: Bollinger band extremes indicate price has moved beyond 2 standard deviations from its recent mean. This typically results from a liquidity-driven overshoot rather than fundamental revaluation. Market makers and statistical arbitrageurs recognize the overshoot and trade against it, while the original directional flow exhausts, creating a natural mean-reversion within 30-90 seconds.
weaknesses: Regime dependency: trending markets ignore bands
Slippage on fast moves: band touches during news
Crowding: Bollinger setups widely discussed on X
prior_art: Price Action + Bollinger (shared by @Mohitsharma202 on X)
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; apply to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index instead of FnO universe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
